places.name: Hat Creek ranch (Montana)
places.note: Call winters in a tent, hangs the thieving boy Big Tom, sees Soupy and Bert quit, and finally makes Newt range boss before leaving.
places.location_hint: on a timbered creek beside the Milk River, between the Milk and Missouri, near the Canadian line in northern Montana

places.name: Milk River
places.note: Newt, Pea and Needle pull bogged yearlings from its mud when Call rides up, gives Newt his mare, rifle and watch, and departs.

places.name: Missouri River
places.note: Spring roundup gathers cattle scattered over the range between it and the Milk.

places.name: Canada
places.note: Call's party follows stolen horses across the line and catches a drunk preacher and his son at breakfast; the old man is shot.
places.location_hint: thieves caught on the third day out, just north of the border from the Milk River ranch

places.name: Fort Benton
places.note: As a test, Newt delivers and sells a herd there and brings home the money; new hands come from the fort.
places.location_hint: on the Missouri River in Montana Territory

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Call resents that Gus left half the herd to the woman living down there.

places.name: Missouri
places.note: Big Tom claims he worked two years at a forge there.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Soupy and Bert head off together hoping to reach it; Call must carry Gus's body there.

places.name: Kentucky
places.note: Home of three ex-soldiers from the fort who hire on.

places.name: Miles City
places.note: Two cowboys come from there hearing of the ranch; Call tells Newt to bank the woman's share there.

places.name: Oregon
places.note: A drifter named Jim lost interest in reaching it and joined the outfit.

places.name: Musselshell River
places.note: Call wishes he had died there alongside Gus.

places.name: Mississippi
places.note: Call's father died there after a drunken fall from a barn loft.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call ignores its cold through sleepless nights; the outfit is the only cattle ranch in the Territory.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: Newt left as range boss, working the Milk River bottoms near headquarters

groups.label: Call
groups.hint: riding south from the ranch with Gus's body on a pack mule, bound for Texas

groups.label: Soupy and Bert
groups.hint: left the ranch headed for Texas
